note: A recorded read of the vendor board, committed so the tracker runs with the network blocked. It records the issue state, the close date and the comment ids of every issue the register cites, plus the one tag the register cites by ref, so a cited completion signal can be re-checked offline. It is a snapshot, not a second source of truth: regenerate it with --live, never by hand.
